description: A host with no sysctl configuration file anywhere: no /etc/sysctl.conf and no .conf in any sysctl.d directory. NOT_APPLICABLE rather than FAIL, because there is no file to have an opinion about — an image built without them, or a host whose kernel settings arrive some other way. What the running kernel currently does is KERNEL-0006's subject, and here it is unhardened, which -0006 reports.
